summary: Server-side edits applied to the prompt before it reaches Claude. Your client keeps the full history locally; the server trims or summarizes what the model actually sees.
combines: Supported on: Beta. Context editing strategies use header `context-management-2025-06-27`; the compaction strategy uses `compact-2026-01-12`.
When combining thinking-block clearing with tool-result clearing, the thinking strategy must come first in `edits`.
The response reports what ran under `context_management.applied_edits`, and `count_tokens` accepts the same field so you can preview the effect.
